items.title: Claude formalized Fermat's Last Theorem
items.oneliner: Anthropic says Claude produced a complete machine-checked Fermat proof in 11 days, pushing AI from coding into formal reasoning.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra reached broad API availability
items.oneliner: GPT-6 Astra is now broadly routable via OpenRouter, signaling frontier models are becoming infrastructure, not special access.

items.title: Google shipped Gemini 3.8 Flash
items.oneliner: Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash improves speed and cost, but still looks like a tactical release before Gemini 4.

items.title: Claude tightened copyrighted content restrictions
items.oneliner: Anthropic updated Claude's system prompt to refuse song lyrics and copyrighted text, turning copyright pressure into product behavior.

items.title: Chromium faces an exploited sandbox RCE
items.oneliner: An actively exploited Chromium sandbox RCE affects all versions, which makes browser patch latency a real enterprise risk.

items.title: Spotify cut Claude Code tokens sharply
items.oneliner: Spotify says Portal cut Claude Code token usage by 90%, proving agent cost control is now a platform feature.

items.title: uutils added compiler-style CLI diagnostics
items.oneliner: uutils Coreutils 0.11.0 adds caret-based error diagnostics, bringing compiler-grade feedback to everyday Unix commands.

items.title: Mullvad is shutting down public DNS
items.oneliner: Mullvad is ending its public encrypted DNS and backing Quad9 instead, a pragmatic sign privacy infrastructure is consolidating.

items.title: AI still struggles with PCB design
items.oneliner: EEBench shows GPT-6 Astra knows electronics theory, but real PCB design still breaks on physical constraints and tolerances.

items.title: European Git hosting is becoming a product
items.oneliner: Pushin's Europe-only Git hosting beta shows sovereignty concerns are finally shaping developer infrastructure choices, not just policy decks.
